title: NGU: berggrunn N250 og N50 – lokal detaljvisning
license: NLOD (NGU source data; mirror has no separate licence statement)
coverageNote: N250 dekker større områder. N50-kartlagte områder har ufullstendig geografisk dekning og tegnes øverst. Fravær av detaljpolygon betyr ikke fravær av berggrunn. Nasjonalt oversiktskart beholdes under detaljlaget.
note: Projected feature collections, not RFC 7946. Original NGU polygons, generalised by service to 20m, repaired only where invalid, clipped to 50km grid and coordinates rounded to 1m; no synthetic or extrapolated coverage. Source codes 417 and 436 lack a renderer/domain label and use explicit unclassified labels and neutral gray.

classificationPalette.normalization: Exact N50 renderer RGB colours are used for the same hovedbergart code at both scales. N250 differs for the null class and codes 130, 131 and 132; these are deliberately harmonised to N50 for one consistent legend. Original per-feature N250 names are retained.
classificationPalette.unclassifiedNote: These N50 source codes lack both renderer entries and domain names. Their polygons and original descriptions are retained, with explicit unclassified labels and neutral #e1e1e1 display colour.
